title: Remove low-rated reviews
statementMd:
Delete all reviews rated below 6, then show the new average rating rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `avg_rating`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
DELETE FROM reviews WHERE rating < 6; SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM reviews;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
